snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 073 - The Invaders Space Invaders 1500 (2001)

DESCRIPTION
The Invaders: Space Invaders 1500 is an Action game, developed by Taito Corporation and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2001.
